title_zh: 心情與原因——我的感受與想法
grammar: 用 How do you feel? 和 I feel... because... 來表達心情和原因
intro_zh: 每個人每天都有不同的心情。有時候開心，有時候難過，有時候擔心。你知道嗎？我們的心情都有原因的。這一課裡，我們要學會用英文表達自己的感受，也要學會解釋為什麼會有這些感受。一起來認識更多關於心情的英文單字吧！
can_do: 能用英文說出自己現在的心情
能聽懂別人問『你感覺如何』並做出回應

sentences.en: On Monday, I felt worried because I had a big test.
sentences.zh: 星期一，我感到擔心，因為我有一場大考。

sentences.en: I tried hard to study, and I hoped I could do well.
sentences.zh: 我努力讀書，希望能考得好。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, I got my test back and felt joy because I got 95 points!
sentences.zh: 星期三，我拿到考卷，感到開心，因為我得到 95 分！

sentences.en: I love playing soccer, so on Friday I felt excited to play with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我熱愛踢足球，所以星期五和朋友踢球時，我感到興奮。

sentences.en: But then my friend got hurt, and I felt sad because he had to cry a little.
sentences.zh: 但是我的朋友受傷了，他哭了，我感到難過。

sentences.en: I decided to help him feel better, so we sat down and talked.
sentences.zh: 我決定幫他感覺更好，所以我們坐下來聊天。

sentences.en: He smiled and said he believed I was a good friend.
sentences.zh: 他笑了，說他相信我是個好朋友。

sentences.en: On Saturday, I enjoyed playing games with my whole family.
sentences.zh: 星期六，我欣賞和全家人一起玩遊戲。

sentences.en: My little sister gave me a kiss and said she wished every day could be like this.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹親吻我，說她希望每一天都能這樣。

sentences.en: I agree with her—happy moments with family mean the most to me!
sentences.zh: 我同意她——和家人在一起的快樂時光對我來說最重要！

grammar_points.title_zh: ① How do you feel? I feel... because...
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來詢問對方的心情，並說明產生這種心情的原因。
table: because I got a new book.
because we will go on a field trip tomorrow.

grammar_points.explain_zh: 在 because 後面可以接動詞原形或動名詞，說明讓你產生這種感覺的動作或狀況。

examples.en: I feel bored because I have nothing to do.
examples.zh: 我感到無聊，因為我什麼事都沒做。

examples.en: She feels proud because she tried her best in the race.
examples.zh: 她感到驕傲，因為她在比賽中盡了全力。

examples.en: They feel surprised because the gift was a kiss from their friend.
examples.zh: 他們感到驚訝，因為禮物是朋友的親吻。

examples.en: He feels worried because he needs to finish his homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 他感到擔心，因為他需要在晚餐前完成功課。

lines.en: How do you feel after school?
I feel tired because I had a math test.
lines.zh: 我感到疲倦，因為我考了數學試。

lines.en: I feel happy because I enjoyed playing soccer with my friends.
lines.zh: 我感到開心，因為我和朋友一起踢足球很享受。

lines.en: I feel a little worried because I need to finish my project tonight.
lines.zh: 我有點擔心，因為我今晚需要完成專案。

lines.en: Don't worry, I believe you can do it!
lines.zh: 別擔心，我相信你可以做到！

sentences.en: I try to learn new words every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都試著學新單字。

sentences.en: She loves to give her mom a kiss before bed.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡睡前親媽媽一口。

sentences.en: He hates watching scary movies because they make him cry.
sentences.zh: 他討厭看恐怖電影，因為會讓他哭。

sentences.en: They agreed to decide on a game to play together.
sentences.zh: 他們同意決定一起玩什麼遊戲。

sentences.en: I guess the surprise party will make everyone feel surprised.
sentences.zh: 我猜驚喜派對會讓每個人感到驚訝。

sentences.en: We hope to win the class competition and feel joy when we do.
sentences.zh: 我們希望贏得班級競賽，贏了時會感到歡樂。

sentences.en: The word "quiet" means you should keep your mind calm.
sentences.zh: 「安靜」的意思是你應該讓心靈保持平靜。

sentences.en: I dream of becoming a scientist and wish to belong to a team that explores space.
sentences.zh: 我夢想成為科學家，並希望屬於一個探索太空的團隊。
